title: Every page of a list
description:
Collect every item from an API that returns results a page at a time.

```
page 1: 3 items, next cursor c2
page 2: 3 items, next cursor c3
page 3: 1 item, no next page
7 items: ada, bob, cy, dee, eve, fay, gus
```
hints: `cursor = None` / `while True:` / call the API / `yield from page["items"]` / `cursor = page["next"]` / `if cursor is None: break` (lesson 3.01).
A generator lets the caller stop early, for example after the first 5 items, without fetching the other pages.
requirements: `fake_api(cursor)` (in the starter) returns `{"items": [...], "next": cursor or None}`.
`fetch_all()` loops until there is no next cursor, as a generator that yields items.
Stop after 100 pages as a safety limit.
stretch: Support offset paging too (`?offset=0&limit=3`) with the same generator interface.
